newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Primadonna said cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Primadonna said cut to hold.

text.p: -- Primadonna Resorts Inc was cut to a hold from a buy rating a Prudential Securities source said on Monday.
-- Primadonna Resorts closed at 19 on Friday.
-- Analyst Joe Coccimiglio said he believes Primadonna's third quarter earnings could come in below consensus estimates of about $0.24.
-- "We're looking for about $0.22," he said. "And given the thin float, not many shares trade publicly, it could be subject to some selling pressure," Coccimiglio said.
